literal_meaning: রূপোর তৈরি চাকা (wheel made of silver)
similar_in_english: Money makes the world go around
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কাছে রূপোর চাকতি থাকায় সে যেকোনো কাজ সাধন করতে পারে।
রূপোর চাকতি ছাড়া এই শহরে কিছু হয় না।
example_sentences_in_english: With the silver wheel in his possession, he can accomplish any task.
Nothing gets done in this city without the silver wheel.
note: The idiom implies that money acts like a wheel that propels or facilitates actions, rooted in traditional Bengali views on wealth's influence.
